## About
Village Automotive Services started out as a Sunoco gas station and grew into a family owned and operated shop on Magie Ave in Union. We are a fully insured repair and maintenance facility, and we work on foreign and domestic cars, SUVs and vans, plus trucks, trailers, buses and construction equipment.
What keeps people coming back is simple: we pay attention to the details and we talk to you plainly about what your vehicle needs. The team from Klisko Services in Elizabeth has also joined us, so there are more experienced hands in the shop.
Give us a call or book online, and tell us what is going on with your car. If you do not see your problem on our list, call anyway and we will talk it through.

## Services
- Brakes: Grinding, vibrating or pulsing when you stop? We inspect and replace pads, shoes, rotors, drums, calipers, hoses and master cylinders, and exchange brake fluid.
- Oil changes: More than fresh oil and a filter. We also check the air filter, top off fluids, grease fittings, look for oil leaks and check belts and hoses.
- Diagnostic testing: Check engine light on or the car feeling sluggish? We run system analysis, pin-point testing and component diagnosis to find the real problem.
- Tire services: Tire installation, balancing, wheel alignments and flat tire repair.
- A/C and heater performance checks: If the A/C barely cools or the cabin will not warm up, stop in and talk with one of our technicians.
- Engine and transmission repair: Maintenance, repair, rebuilds, replacement and transmission flushes for imports and domestic vehicles.
- Fleet maintenance: Our mobile truck comes to you for on-site preventative maintenance, inspections and repairs.
- Transporting vehicles: Stuck after an accident, stalled on the roadside, or need a vehicle moved? Call us for pricing.
- Private inspection facility: We are a State of New Jersey private inspection facility.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on hybrid and electric vehicles?
A: Yes. Electric and hybrid vehicle repair is on our service list.

Q: Can you service my company vehicles where they are?
A: Yes. Our mobile truck handles on-site preventative maintenance, inspections and repairs for fleets.

Q: What if the repair I need is not on your list?
A: Give us a call and tell us what is happening. We will talk through what your vehicle needs.

Q: How do I schedule an appointment?
A: Call us at 908-289-1423 or use the online booking form.
